_comment: Run config for the ARE01 / COSM consumer survey (questionnaire v8). Applies to every path: pins the screeners' qualifying answers, passes the three attention checks and fills the dollar write-ins, so a walk reaches the end. Path-specific pins live in paths.json; outline/build_run_blocks.py puts the two together into paste-ready blocks. Order matters: the first rule whose `match` fits a question wins, so path pins go in front of these.
_derived: Q2 gender: Male/Female/Other — 'Prefer not to answer' terminates
Q3 state (dropdown): California — 'I do not live in the United States' terminates
Q4 ZIP (must be a US postal code): 90301, Inglewood CA — the Cosm Los Angeles market, and consistent with Q3
Q5 income: $75,000 to $99,999 — 'Prefer not to answer' terminates
Attention checks (p.44 TERMINATE criteria): AC1 Broccoli, AC2 the number 4, AC3 Dog — every other answer terminates

Dollar write-ins Q21/Q83/Q84/Q88/Q99: amounts inside the stated $0-$10,000 / $0-$1,000 ranges; the exclusive 'I would not pay / attend / spend' box beside each is left unticked (fixed: '(?!)' never matches, so a checkbox stays blank while the amount box gets `value`)
